QuestInfo.name: Chil Sung's Roasted Pork
QuestInfo.0: Apparently, the place that makes the best roasted pork in Korean Folk Town is Chil Sung's...
QuestInfo.1: I went to Chil Sung's place because he was apparently the best at making roasted pork in Folk Town. He asked for 5 Moon Bunny's Pounders and 1,000 mesos in return for roasted pork.\n\n#t4000169# #b#c4000169##k/5
QuestInfo.2: I gave Chil Sung 5 #t4000169#s and 1,000 mesos for 1 roasted pork.

0.0: Hello, it's been a while. How can I help you? \r\n#L0# #bCan I get some roasted pork?#k
0.1: Roasted pork? Well, I can say with great confidence that I'm the best at making those. Since you have helped us last time, I'll promise to make you a plate full if you can help me out a little bit here.

yes.0: I've been stacking up the crops and pounding them on the mortar, but the Pounder broke. If you can get me #b5 Pounders#k from the Moon Bunnies, then I'll make the roasted pork for you for only #b1000 mesos#k.

no.0: Didn't you come because you needed some roasted pork?

1.0: Oh my gosh, you really found it! Well, now that you brought the Pounder, here's the roasted pork.

yes.0: If you ever find yourself in need of Roasted Pork, please come talk to me. It only takes me 2 hours to make a plate full of it.

item.0: I'll give you roasted pork after you get me 5 Pounder.
